restaurantName: Le Cin5 - Au Cœur du Village
address: 26 montée du Château, La Clusaz, 74220, France
bio: Vincent Deforce is a fan of the island of Mauritius, from whence he brings back ideas, ingredients and spices that he cleverly mixes with Savoie produce, creating inventive, attractive dishes. Rich in colour, Savoie saffron rubs shoulders with island chilis, marlin and octopus are mixed with sarrazin crozets (local pasta) and zander from Lake Geneva, without forgetting the delicious tartiflette of sweet potatoes and slow-roasted pork – unforgettable!...
pageTitle: Le Cin5 - Au Cœur du Village
